# Retired Tutorials

> A collection of legacy tutorials and walkthroughs that are no longer part of our active navigation.

We periodically update and retire our tutorials to ensure the documentation matches the latest features of Zencoder and Zenflow.

Below are the retired tutorials and where their updated or corresponding guides reside:

### Spec-Driven Development Guide

* **Description:** Original guide explaining Spec-Driven Development (SDD) concepts.
* **New Home:** You can find the updated conceptual explanation and step-by-step workflows under [Spec First Workflow](/zenflow/workflows/spec-first).

### Render Deployment Tutorial

* **Description:** A step-by-step tutorial on deploying applications to Render using Zenflow.
* **New Home:** Refer to the [Zenflow Quickstart](/zenflow/quickstart) for setting up and deploying projects.

### Figma to Code Tutorial

* **Description:** Creating responsive web pages from Figma designs using AI agents.
* **New Home:** Refer to the [Zenflow Quickstart](/zenflow/quickstart) or explore Customizing.

### Generate Codebase Diagrams

* **Description:** How to use agents to generate diagrams and architecture visualizations of your repositories.
* **New Home:** Learn more in the [Zenflow Quickstart](/zenflow/quickstart) and [Coding Agent](/features/coding-agent) sections.

### OSS Contributor Tutorial

* **Description:** Walkthrough of using Zenflow to contribute to open-source software.
* **New Home:** Learn core parallel agent flows in the [Zenflow Quickstart](/zenflow/quickstart).

### Refactoring Enterprise Java with Zenflow

* **Description:** Large-scale refactoring of legacy Java codebases using agentic pipelines.
* **New Home:** See [Zenflow Quickstart](/zenflow/quickstart) or explore Customizing.
